title: Japanese-Style Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic chicken dish inspired by Japanese cuisine, cooked in a traditional Moroccan tagine.

ingredients.name: tagine spice blend
ingredients.notes: or a combination of cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and turmeric

ingredients.name: honey
ingredients.notes: or maple syrup for a different flavor

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the tagine spice blend, soy sauce, and honey.
Rub the spice mixture all over the chicken breast, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat a large oven-safe skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken breast for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the sushi rice according to package instructions.
To assemble the dish, place a scoop of sushi rice on a plate, followed by a slice of the cooked chicken breast.
Garnish with chopped green onions and sesame seeds.
